summary: Nearest-neighbor spatial query. When a starting node (a3) is given, walks two linked lists (next pointers at +0x110 and +0x10C from node base) to find the closest node to query point a2 by squared XZ distance, then applies a signed plane-proximity test via sub_4FB6D0. When a3 is null, initializes best candidates to huge sentinel values and scans the strut array (base this+0x134, stride 316, count this+0x130), keeping the closest strut and the closest candidate that passes the plane test. Returns the closest qualifying node pointer, or the plane-verified candidate if the final signed-distance check is non-negative.

operations.description: Branch on whether a starting node a3 is provided; when null, candidate pointers and scores are initialized to sentinel values (0 pointers, FLT_MAX scores).
Walk first linked list from node a3 via next pointer at node+0x110, tracking the node with minimum squared XZ distance to the query point.
Walk second linked list from node a3 via next pointer at node+0x10C, updating the nearest node when a closer squared XZ distance is found.
Call sub_4FB6D0(a2) to obtain signed distance from query point to a reference plane; if negative, return the nearest node found so far.
Compute candidate plane-proximity score: squared XYZ distance to best node with a 4x-weighted Z component, and (signed_distance + 30)^2 as acceptance radius.
Guard on strut scan count this+0x130 > 0; enables the stride-316 loop over the strut array at this+0x134.
Iterate strut entries (count this+0x130, base this+0x134, stride 316); entries whose type field at entry+0x12C is <= 1 are distance-tested against the query point.
Track the strut with the smallest weighted squared distance as the primary candidate v8.
When a plane-validated candidate (signed distance > 0) is closer than the acceptance radius, call sub_4FB6D0(a2) again and keep the strut with the smaller signed distance.
Final call to sub_4FB6D0(a2); if the signed distance is non-negative return the plane-verified candidate v28, otherwise return the nearest node v8.
Return the selected node pointer (nearest node or plane-verified candidate).
